execution_conditions: Run once in the existing fixed P2 worktree at exact HEAD, with no source or manifest edits.
Recheck P3 status, free memory >=20%, disk available >=30 GiB, no new conflicting scorer and P2 output absent immediately before launch.
Run preflight first, then the frozen runner with this gate; no online solver or additional cells.
Preserve ledger, official originals, failed or timed-out results and surviving-child evidence; stop on first infrastructure failure.
Shared-host E0 and elapsed time must be reported as parallel observations, not dedicated-machine performance.
boundary: This is a separate six-cell P2 gate in parallel with the unchanged P3 frozen run; no change to P3 deadline, source, output, E0 cap, or cleanup. It does not admit P2 full500, retries, cloud, E1, E2, or offline winner selection.
